Merger Consideration is the aggregate of Dodgers Common Stock issuable pursuant to the Exchange Ratio (0.70 Dodgers Common Stock per Cubs Common Stock outstanding, excluding Excluded Shares) plus cash paid in lieu of fractional shares; Excluded Shares receive no consideration.
0.70 Dodgers Common Stock per Cubs Common Stock (Exchange Ratio); cash in lieu of fractional shares (amount per Section 1.9(e)); and the conversion of Cubs RSUs, PSUs, and Options into Dodgers securities or cash as described (Converted RSUs; Converted PSUs; Option Cash Payments). There are no CVRs mentioned in the provided text. The Merger Consideration is the aggregate Dodgers stock issuable under the Exchange Ratio plus cash in lieu of fractional shares.
0.70 Dodgers Common Stock per Cubs Common Stock, subject to adjustment under Section 1.6(b); Merger Consideration includes cash in lieu of fractional shares per Section 1.6(c).
